content.text: Now let's do a final verification and list all files:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && echo "=== FINAL ARCHIVE VERIFICATION ===" && echo && echo "Files in archive:" && ls -lh *.tsv *.py *.txt *.md 2>/dev/null && echo && echo "=== CHECKSUM VERIFICATION ===" && echo && echo "Original file:" && sha256sum met_inventory_original.tsv && echo && echo "Standardized file:" && sha256sum met_inventory_standardized.tsv && echo && echo "=== ARCHIVE SUMMARY ===" && wc -l met_inventory_original.tsv met_inventory_standardized.tsv && echo && du -sh . && echo && echo "✓ Archive ready for download"
input.description: Final verification and listing of all archive files
